locals: The sky came back with feet. It still walks like weather.
Kith kept meeting while you were away. The bench was never empty for long.
Pim kept the bench warm for you.

notes.title: Your name came first
notes.science: What others heard about you shapes how they first meet you. A good name lets strangers trust each other before they meet.
notes.limits: Here a rumor is one number, and only some locals hold it.
notes.counter: A first meeting can still undo a rumor.
notes.question: What did Kith hear about you while you were away?

sources.label: Evolution of Indirect Reciprocity, Nowak and Sigmund, 2005
The Evolution of Trust, Nicky Case

notes.title: A culture while you were away
notes.science: Kith kept meeting without you, and each postcard you sent nudged how it met. Habits pass from creature to creature, like a culture.
notes.limits: Each postcard moves one dial by a tenth, for every creature.
notes.counter: A place can change for reasons no letter could reach.
notes.question: Did Kith hold together?

sources.label: Cultural Evolution, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
Why Copy Others?, Rendell and others, 2010
